decision_conditions: The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

<p>The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and <span style="font-size: 14px;">documents:&nbsp;</span></p><p><span style="font-size: 14px; line-height: 107%; font-family: Arial, sans-serif;">24/110/101, 24/110/102,
24/110/103, 24/110/104 Rev A, 24/110/105, 24/110/106, 24/110/501, 24/110/502
Rev A, Location Plan, Design and Access Statement (24-110/AB), CIL Form 1,
Transport Statement P24164 TS/PC (Crosby Transport Planning Limited, Nov 2024)</span></p>

<p>The use hereby permitted shall not be open to customers outside the following times:- </p><p>06.00 hours to 22.00 hours, Monday to Saturday inclusive, and </p><p>06.00 hours to 18:00 hours on Sundays, without the prior written permission of the local planning authority.</p>

<span lang="EN-US" style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: Arial, sans-serif;"><span style="font-size: 14px;">Works should not begin until a Delivery and Servicing Plan has first been
submitted to the Local Planning Authority in writing to be agreed.&nbsp; </span><span style="font-size: 14px;">The delivery and service plan shall be
carried out in accordance with the approved details for the lifetime of the
development.</span></span>
The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

<p><span lang="EN-US" style="font-size:11.0pt;font-family:
&quot;Swiss721BT-Roman&quot;,sans-serif;mso-fareast-font-family:Swiss721BT-Roman;
mso-bidi-font-family:Swiss721BT-Roman;mso-ansi-language:EN-US;mso-fareast-language:
EN-US;mso-bidi-language:AR-SA">Prior to commencement of development, details of an
adequate cycle rack system and their dimensions shall be submitted to and
approved in writing by the local planning authority. The cycle storage shall be
made available prior to occupation and shall be retained thereafter.&nbsp; LB Harrow do not support the provision of
vertical cycle storage as this excludes less able people from being able to
securely store their cycle.</span></p>
description: Change of Use from a restaurant (Class E (b)) at nos. 2 & 3 Station Parade to a retail shop (Class E (a)) and to amalgamate with the existing retail shop at no. 1 Station Parade. Demolition of existing single storey rear extensions at nos. 2 & 3, single storey extension, and detached building at rear of no. 1 and erection of a single storey rear extension to all three units
